title: Freight Damage Tracking Log
subtitle: Freight Damage: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Freight Damage Tracking Log covers freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action. The freight exception coordinator records Freight Damage events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Freight Damage Tracking Log keeps Freight Damage exceptions visible until the freight exception coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Freight Damage Tracking Log at trailer, dock, warehouse zone, delivery location, and protected evidence area. Document freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action identity before Freight Damage begins. Compare freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action findings with stated Freight Damage criteria; route unresolved Freight Damage issues to claims or cargo-condition reviewer. For Freight Damage Tracking Log, confirm requirements for Freight Damage. Ask claims or cargo-condition reviewer to review Freight Damage conditions beyond the freight exception coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking variance reference and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Freight Damage, identify responsible parties, trailer, dock, warehouse zone, delivery location, and protected evidence area, and the linked freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action source.

fields.label: Shipment, order, bill, and claim reference
Carrier, trailer, seal, and custody identifiers
Item, lot, serial, package, and affected-quantity identity

sections.title: Status variance and accountable response
sections.guidance: Capture Freight Damage facts for freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Freight Damage tracked controls
items: Damage type, location, extent, and discovery time
Packaging, pallet, restraint, and moisture condition
Seal, vehicle, dock, and handling context
Salvage, quarantine, rework, or mitigation action

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Keep the Freight Damage chronology intact through handoff. State the unresolved exception, the owner selected by Freight Exception Coordinator, and the next control point.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Product creates safety or contamination concern
Liability or disposition decision requested without review
blocks.guidance: Pause Freight Damage when affected scope, evidence preservation, safe containment, notice, or authorized disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Freight Damage proof and route unresolved freight unit, packaging, damage area, affected quantity, custody event, and mitigation action scope to freight exception coordinator.
